reasoning_content:
The login returned 200 (not 302), and session cookie set. Let me check whether we're logged in by checking the page shows current-user-id. Actually earlier summary claimed POST returns 302. Here it returned 200. Let me check the response content for user id.

The admin after login returned 302 (which is a redirect - meaning not authenticated, since /admin redirects). Hmm, /admin returns 302 even for anonymous. Let me verify login actually succeeded by checking data-current-user-id.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" -o /tmp/login.html; echo "current-user:"; grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"' /tmp/login.html | head; grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"' <(curl -s -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/) | head; echo "--- admin with session ---"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value=\"//;s/\"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode \"authenticity_token=$TOKEN\" --data-urlencode \"user[email]=admin@consul.dev\" --data-urlencode \"user[password]=Aa12345678\" -o /tmp/login.html; echo \"current-user:\"; grep -o 'data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"' /tmp/login.html | head; grep -o 'data-current-user-id=\"[^\"]*\"' <(curl -s -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/) | head; echo \"--- admin with session ---\"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\\n\" http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify login session user id"}
